scripts.text: Good day. My name is Leablem,
and I'm a technician that specializes in
adding slots to weapons and armors.
scripts.translation: 為武器和防具開卡槽的技術員。

scripts.text: It can be very hard sometimes, but I like
scripts.translation: 有時工作很辛苦，不過我喜歡

scripts.text: what I do, and take pride in it.
I've learned most of the things from my brother, Seyablem,
scripts.translation: 我大部分本領都是跟哥哥賽亞佈雷姆學的，

scripts.text: but I think I still have a lot to learn.
scripts.translation: 不過我覺得自己還有很多要學。

scripts.text: So please understand my slotting services are limited,
scripts.translation: 所以請理解，我能提供的開槽服務有限，
不像哥哥賽亞佈雷姆那樣全面。

scripts.text: My brother wasn't so happy to teach me
scripts.translation: 哥哥起初不太願意教我

scripts.text: his skills because he was worried that his skills
scripts.translation: 他的本領，因為擔心自己的技術

scripts.text: wouldn't be unique anymore. He did, however, his best

scripts.text: Thanks to him, I've learned lots of things.
